reading.title: Alex Builds a Secret Door
reading.contextZh: Alex 想要用紅石做一扇自動門，讓我們看看他怎麼做。
paragraphs: Alex enters a large underground cave in his Minecraft world to collect materials for a new redstone machine. He needs redstone dust, iron ingots, and smooth stone blocks to build an automatic secret door.
First, Alex places the redstone block on the stone floor. He attaches two iron doors next to the cave wall. Then he carefully connects redstone dust between the power source and the heavy iron doors.
When Alex steps on the stone pressure plate, the redstone signal activates immediately and the two doors open smoothly. Alex smiles because his machine works perfectly without making any noise.
He puts the extra redstone dust back into his inventory. Building working machines in the cave gives Alex great confidence to explore deeper underground tunnels with his friends tomorrow.
readingTipsZh: 注意 Alex 使用了哪些材料。

instruction.titleZh: be 動詞判斷三步反射心法
instruction.explanationZh: 看到句子先找主詞：一個物品（單數）或 he/she/it ➔ 立即配 is；兩個以上（複數）或 they/we ➔ 立即配 are。小心別被後面的名詞騙了！
patterns: 【觸發訊號】主詞是 1 個（單數 / he / she / it） ➔ 配 is
【觸發訊號】主詞是 2 個以上（複數 / we / they） ➔ 配 are

workedExamples.example: The redstone block is on the floor.
workedExamples.walkthroughZh: 【第1步找主詞】The redstone block 是 1 個方塊（單數）➔ 【第2步選動詞】配 is。

workedExamples.example: Two iron doors are next to the wall.
workedExamples.walkthroughZh: 【第1步找主詞】Two iron doors 是 2 扇門（複數）➔ 【第2步選動詞】配 are。

commonMistakes.wrong: The block with two torches are red.
commonMistakes.corrected: The block with two torches is red.
commonMistakes.whyZh: 【陷阱】眼睛不要只看前面的 torches！真正的主詞是 The block（單數），所以一定要用 is。

questions.prompt: The machine with many redstone parts _____ ready.
Why did Alex connect the redstone dust to the doors?
Write a sentence with "Two machines are".

answers.explanationZh: 第 2 段第 1 句明確指出 "The first redstone block is on the floor"，故選 B。
answers.likelyMisconceptionZh: 容易選 C：因為文章提到鐵門（iron doors），但那是放在牆邊（next to the wall），不是放紅石方塊的位置。

answers.explanationZh: 主詞是 The redstone block（單數），故使用 is。
answers.likelyMisconceptionZh: 容易選 B（are）：因為看到介系詞片語中的 red dust 誤以為是複數名詞，但真正主詞只有一個 block。

answers.explanationZh: 主詞是 Two iron doors（複數兩扇門），故選 are。
answers.likelyMisconceptionZh: 容易選 A（is）：因為看到 room 是單數而混淆，應認清主詞核心是 doors。

answers.explanationZh: 第 2 段說明 Alex 仔細連接紅石粉至鐵門。

answers.answer: His redstone circuit successfully opened the iron doors.
answers.explanationZh: 第 3 段指出當他踩上壓力板時門順利開啟，驗證機關成功，故選 B。
answers.likelyMisconceptionZh: 容易選 C：因為文章第 1 段確實提到 inventory，但那是準備階段，並非結尾開心的原因。

answers.answer: It requires careful connection of materials.
answers.explanationZh: 文章強調仔細連接紅石粉與材料方能成功運作。
answers.likelyMisconceptionZh: 容易選 B：文章並未說機器總是失敗，結尾證明能成功。

answers.explanationZh: 單數主詞 The machine 正確搭配 is 與形容詞/副詞。
複數代名詞 They 正確搭配 are。
Alex 是第三人稱單數，搭配 is。
主詞是 The machine（單數），故選 is。
answers.likelyMisconceptionZh: 容易選 B（are）：被介系詞片語 parts 誤導。

acceptedAnswers: To make the secret door work.
answers.explanationZh: Alex 連接紅石粉是為了讓壓力板能觸發開門。
